description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_Printer`, which provides methods for rendering HTML elements, text, and tables, mainly for debugging or diagnostics purposes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for generating start/end tags, complete elements, escaping HTML content, and retrieving class information of objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer
classes.description: A utility class for rendering HTML elements, text, and property rows, primarily for debugging or visualization purposes within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method, currently empty, initializes the printer object.

methods.name: prepareGenerator
methods.description: Prepares the generator object with configuration and context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Generates an opening HTML tag with attributes.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Generates a complete HTML element with optional escaping of content.

methods.name: elementEmpty
methods.description: Generates a self-closing or empty HTML element.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Generates HTML for a text token.

methods.name: row
methods.description: Creates an HTML table row with key/value data, converting booleans to 'On'/'Off'.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe HTML output, including UTF-8 cleaning and special character encoding.

methods.name: listify
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into a comma-separated list, optionally adding 'and' for politeness.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of an object without prefixes, including metadata for certain class types.
